Residential permits are not permitted on commercial vehicles, in accordance with Miami-Dade
Sec. 33-124.1. Vehicles cannot be stored for more than 48 hours in the same parking space.

By execution of this Residential Parking Permit Application, as evidenced by my signature below, I hereby swear
and affirm that (a) I am a legal resident of the City of Miami Beach, Florida, (b) all information and
documentation provided in connection with this Application is true and correct, and (c) I fully understand that
all permits are the sole property of the City of Miami Beach Parking Department. I further acknowledge and
agree that any visitor permits provided to me are for the exclusive use of my guests; there is a limit of 30 visitor
permits per quarter (3-month period), per household, per zone.

By signing below, I acknowledge that said permit(s) are for the sole use of the above resident and not intended
for resale and are non-transferable. Any violation(s) of the above guidelines may result in termination of parking
privileges.

You will be receiving an invitation email with instructions on how to create a secure online Parking Portal
account where you will be able to:
• Pay for your permit renewal.
• Purchase virtual Visitor Permits.

To renew your residential status, you will receive a letter in the mail with a code to verify your residency.
For more information, please visit www.miamibeachfl.gov/city-hall/parking/ or call (305) 673-7505.
